name: Kagami
source:
A priest who protects the town church alone. No matter what happens, he keeps believing in God's love.

He is concerned that most young people aren't concerned about the church anymore.

[Translated from [url=http://b-cluster.eek.jp/requartz/character/kagami.html]official website[/url]]
